items.title: Multiplication by an element outside the minimal primes is surjective on the top local cohomology of every finite module
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that on a Noetherian local ring of dimension d, multiplication by an element not contained in any minimal prime of dimension d is surjective on the top local cohomology of every finite module, whatever the ideal and whatever the local cohomological dimension of that ideal (author lemma at source lines 3631-3637, label lemma-top-coh-divisible). The proof (source lines 3639-3646) is a support-and-dimension argument: the quotient by f has support of dimension below d so its top local cohomology vanishes, which gives one surjection from the long exact sequence, while the bound cd(A, I) \leq d gives the surjection in the other direction. H2.
